$about: composite-tab-stop: CLOSED 11 Aug 2026. 12 violations -> 0. Kept because the file's own prediction was half right and half wrong, and both halves are worth having on record.
closed_by: e58145f — the rule's third exemption: a container that IS the tab stop
33e40c9 — useComboboxWiring, plus the rule's fourth exemption

what_this_file_got_right.the_mechanism: Exactly as predicted. Base UI wires aria-controls and aria-activedescendant in a ref callback after mount, so the served input pointed at nothing. Eight of the twelve were real and were fixed by minting the list id during render.
what_this_file_got_right.the_fix: Also as predicted, down to the name: 'a useComboboxWiring beside useFieldWiring and useOpenMirror, minting the listbox id at render'. That is what shipped.
what_this_file_got_right.why_not_silenced: The strongest thing here. A draft narrowing matched any role=combobox sharing a parentElement — blindness by adjacency — and this paragraph is what rejected it. The exemption that shipped requires aria-controls BY ID and a tabbable owner.

what_this_file_got_wrong.claim: 'list-box.tsx, still on React Aria and in this list for a different reason. The rule is right; the code is not finished.'
what_this_file_got_wrong.correction: The rule was wrong about list-box, and the code was finished. React Aria's collections make the COLLECTION tabbable while manager.focusedKey is null and marshal focus into the first item on entry — useSelectableCollection computes `tabIndex = focusedKey == null ? 0 : -1` in the RENDER BODY, and useSelectableItem computes the mirror in the same pass. The two swap atomically; there is never a moment with two stops. The served shape, role=listbox tabindex=0 with all options at -1, IS a tab stop.
what_this_file_got_wrong.why_it_was_missed: The rule's header had described that exact case from the beginning — 'the CONTAINER is the tab stop and its items are correctly all -1'. It only ever DETECTED it via aria-activedescendant, which React Aria does not use here. A rule can carry a correct description of an exemption it does not implement, and nothing will say so.
what_this_file_got_wrong.severity_honest_was_also_soft: This file called the defect 'scoped to the always-open demo shape'. True of autocomplete and command; it was not true of list-box, which was never a defect at all.

the_lesson_kept: Two different findings under one violation count is why they sat here for weeks. A count is not a diagnosis. See DECISIONS.md §13.
